last_result.headline: Q13 closed with the most informative negative of the Q-series: a hybrid emission that is clearly BETTER pointwise produces a clearly WORSE trajectory. Emission level: |argmax error| 185.8 -> 149.4 ft, helping 67.5% of 40 held-out wells, and the typewell-uncertainty gate stratifies perfectly monotonically. DP level: nested w=0 (typewell only) 12.861 is best, every hybrid weight worse (13.256-14.479). Cause: the self emission is coverage-masked, so it pulls the path toward the prefix TVT range - a good per-row bet but a cumulative bias once chained, working against drift which dominates the residual. New standing rule recorded: a pointwise emission metric is not a valid proxy for trajectory quality when the modification carries a directional bias.
